root_cause: The canonical Netlify applicability authority already classifies tools/ci/** as governance-only, but Production Source Snapshot and Production Release Readback did not mirror that domain in push.paths-ignore. As a result, tools/ci-only main changes still allocated both production runners before the in-job classifier could skip deployment.

evidence.in_job_outcome: Both workflows completed successfully without requiring a Netlify production mutation, proving admission—not runtime deployment logic—was the remaining waste.

prevention.early_trigger: Production Source Snapshot and Production Release Readback both ignore tools/ci/** when it is the only changed domain.
prevention.mixed_runtime_changes: A commit that also changes website, portal, or Netlify-hosted runtime remains admitted and fail-closed.
